summary: Block 16, analysis only. (2) Audited (O'') and RETRACTED 'strictly weaker than the step ban', with quantifier analysis and two countermodels on the abstract data (S, theta): one where (O'') holds while adjacent transitions occur a.e. so the ban fails; one with disjoint supports where the ban holds vacuously and (O'') fails at a = 0. They are incomparable; O' and O'' are withdrawn as bridges. Replacement is (B): for a.e. a the six lists S r satisfy (R), (D), (N), (V) over existing predicates, which is exactly the 21-lemma asset's hypothesis set. Availability: (R) is normalisation, (N) needs (D)-grade input, (D) is NOT palette_neighbor_disjoint (two centres at one angle, versus one centre at two angles), and (V) has one producer, five_endpoint_no_common, needing a second FiveCenter that no lemma constructs. The obstruction is a missing construction, not a missing estimate.
verified_results: [verified here, by definition] The rfl correction: Lean proof irrelevance makes any two proofs of the same proposition definitionally equal, so 'KernelCompact.norm_integral_sq ... = ProbabilityL2.norm_integral_sq ... := rfl' holds for every pair of proofs of that statement and says nothing about implementation identity. SmokeNames.lean and dedup-norm-integral-sq/CANDIDATE.md corrected accordingly; the remaining claims are same-type plus the source reading of the wrapper body.

[proved here] Countermodel 1 ((O'') holds, step ban fails): with g 60-periodic with dense level sets and theta t = (g t + floor(t/60)) mod 5, every level set is dense so every fiveSupport is R and S a = Fin 5 for all a, giving (O'') trivially, while theta(t+60) = theta t + 1 a.e. produces adjacent transitions on a full-measure set, which is what the step ban forbids.

[proved here] Countermodel 2 (step ban holds, (O'') fails): with supp i = union over n of [5n+i, 5n+i+1], supports are pairwise disjoint so the step ban's hypotheses are never met and it holds vacuously, while at a = 0 the state 0 is present and 60 lies only in supp 0, so no adjacent witness exists in Nb 0 = {1,4} and (O'') fails.

[concluded here] (O'') and the step ban are incomparable on the data they quantify over (support sets versus theta values); the claim 'strictly weaker' in block 15 is retracted, and (O') (a.e. second-centre existence) is withdrawn as unmotivated.
